window_selection: first 180 scenario seconds, all cameras, chosen without opening identity annotations

selection.objective: maximum labeled pairwise global-ID F1 among eligible development runs; recall denominator includes all mappable baseline tracklets, including crop exclusions
selection.tie_break: higher evaluable link precision, then higher similarity threshold, then variant name
selection.no_eligible_candidate: retain original ImageNet prefix and association policy; report no qualified improvement

evaluation_rule: freeze chosen config and development results before opening S05 GT; run one selected configuration; no S05 tuning
evaluation_input_repair: explicitly exclude and record nonpositive baseline boxes; S05 metadata-only inspection found two source rows, one inside the fixed window; all other validation remains strict
limitations: S01 development is small and may not transfer to S05
S05 shares cameras and location with previously inspected S04; novel-site or novel-identity generalization is not claimed
Partial identity labels limit evaluation coverage; unknown links are not verified correct
No fine-tuning or GPU dependency is introduced in this checkpoint
